remarks: Stunning Large Multi Family Colonial Home in the Desirable Spring Hill Area! **Great Opportunity for INVESTORS or HOMEOWNER'S Alike** Everything has been Tastefully Redone from Top to Bottom in the Last Year or so! Significant Quality Modern Updates Throughout! Unit 1 - LR, Dining Area, Kitchen w/SS Appliances, Wine Cooler, Granite Counters, Abundant Cabinet and Storage Space, Sliders to Patio, THREE Bedrooms and 2 FULL Baths (1,157 Sq Ft). Unit 2 - 2 Level Duplex with FOUR Bedrooms and TWO Full Baths (1,365 Sq Ft). The First Floor is VERY Spacious, Light and Bright. LR, Dining Area, Kitchen with SS Appliances, Granite Counter, Wood Cabinets, and TWO Nice Size Bedrooms W/Full Bath. Second Floor of the Duplex has TWO Bedrooms, Jack and Jill Shared Full Bathroom, Laundry/Storage Room, and Plenty of Closet Space. Both units have New Flooring, Recessed Lighting, Bathrooms with New Fixtures, Lighting and Tile, and W/D Hookups. The 2024 Beautifully Finished Basement/Lower Level with it's own Private Entrance. It Adds an Additional 4 Rooms of Versatile Heated/Cooled Living Space with Full Bath. So many possibilities!! Currently used as extra living space for Family, Recreation, and Storage, But, a Possible 3rd Unit with City Approval?? Buyer to do Due Their Own Due Diligence with the City Regarding THEIR Options. New Clean Gas Heat and Hot Water Units, Central Air, All New Windows, New Vinyl Siding, Off Street Parking, 10 Parking Spaces, Huge Private Yard, .24 Acres.
